pages.title: Install, then activate
pages.text: Wear power armor or hold an Enhanced Energy Sabre or Energy Lance. Press the configuration key, normally $(thing)0$(), and select a piece.$(br2)Click a module icon to install or remove it. The checkbox enables it; the last control assigns hotkey group $(thing)1–4$(). Carry an Energy Holder and refill it through its own panel or Automatic collection. The equipment panel shows its charge at the bottom. Keep usage within this piece’s limit, normally 100 or 130 with Energy enabled.

pages.title: Return or close
pages.text: Press the configuration key again from an equipment panel or the help page to return to the equipment selection menu.$(br2)Press it while the selection menu is open to close the panel.

pages.title: Respect each piece’s limit
pages.text: The Energy Holder supplies one shared fuel pool, while each piece keeps its own module budget. Active modules normally have to fit within $(thing)100$() usage. An enabled Energy module raises this to $(thing)130$() and reduces that piece’s draw on the holder.$(br2)Overloaded pieces stop their powered abilities. Other equipment can keep working. Disable an ability or add Energy before heading into danger.

pages.title: Set up quick toggles
pages.text: Assign modules to a hotkey group in the equipment panel. One group can toggle several modules across your worn armor and held weapon.$(br2)Groups 1 and 2 default to Numpad 7 and 8. Set the other groups in Controls.$(br2)Test fuel, activation and movement before a risky climb or fight.
